title: Hiragi-san's House of Vampires
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Shota Minamoto, an orphaned junior-high student living in a children's home, is adopted by a warm, wealthy family in a Japanese-style estate (K Manga blurb). The family hides a secret: they are vampires (AniList and MangaUpdates tags). K Manga calls it a cozy, bloody love comedy from the creator of The Cuckoo's Fiancé.
life_message: A family is made by welcome and acceptance, even when the people who take you in are not what they seem.

content.note: MangaUpdates lists attempted murder and murderers; K Manga says 'bloody'. Detail unknown (to verify).
Vampire secret and blood-drinking played mainly for comedy (blurb, tags).
Romantic comedy with a female-harem setup (AniList tag); MangaDex rates it suggestive.

dominant: Adoption and found family; supernatural household secret; harem romcom
